content:
Hey, Lisa. Let's go ride the merry-go-round.
What is that?
It's a game we can play. Follow me.
Okay, Carol. Let's go.
Here you get on. I'll push.
Wow! This goes fast. Jump on!
Okay. Here I go!
Yay! This is fun!
